gloss_en: I need to buy a new phone
notes: [tech] French donor: telephone→talafon (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline reads Latin as en-GB→tilifun. French is Morocco's live CS matrix (heath2020); frame register harrell1962/ennaji2004.

gloss_en: I cook in the kitchen with my mom
notes: [daily] French donor: cuisine→kwizin (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→kuːzin. durative ka-n- (ennaji2004); French loan layer heath2020.

gloss_en: this door opens automatically
notes: [tech] French donor: automatique→otomatik (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→aatumatikw. hād demonstrative + ka- durative passive (harrell1962).

gloss_en: this service is not good
notes: [commerce] French donor: service→saɣfis (o2i donor=fr-FR, ʁ→ɣ); pipeline en-GB→sarfis. māši negator + mzyan 'good' (harrell1962).

gloss_en: I went to the pharmacy to buy medicine
notes: [daily] French donor: pharmacie→faɣmasi (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→faːrmasiː. mšit 1sg past (harrell1962); French loan heath2020.

gloss_en: I want to go to the cinema tonight
notes: [daily] French donor: cinema→sinama (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→sinima. bɣit 'I want' + n- imperfect (ennaji2004).

gloss_en: I took a very nice photo
notes: [daily] French donor: photo→foto (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→futu. zwin 'nice', bzzaf 'a lot' (harrell1962); heavy onset ṣṣwwrt from syncope (heath2020).

gloss_en: I need to see a doctor now
notes: [daily] French donor: docteur→dokte (o2i donor=fr-FR, final r dropped); pipeline en-GB→duktiar. xaṣṣni 'I must' + daba 'now' (harrell1962).

sentence: نْشُوفَك فْ weekend إِنْ شاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك ف weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːfak f wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔ ˈallah
gloss_en: see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] English loan weekend→wiːkind via en-GB donor (default pan-Arabic table, Watson2002/Holes2004); youth English CS layer (heath2020). frame harrell1962.

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with the staff
notes: [work] English loan meeting→miːtinɡ (needs final /ɡ/, which MA declares); en-GB donor. ʕndi 'I have', xddama 'workers' (harrell1962).

gloss_en: did you see the manager in the office
notes: [work] English loan manager→manadʒar (ʒ, not Cairene ɡ; heath2020 MA jīm=/ʒ/); en-GB donor. šfti 2sg past (harrell1962).

gloss_en: I want to buy online
notes: [commerce] English loan online→unlin via en-GB donor; bɣit + n- imperfect (ennaji2004).

gloss_en: I bought a new car
notes: [automotive] iconic MA French loan ṭomobil 'car' (<Fr. automobile; harrell1962, heath2020). Pipeline over-lengthens the vocalised form → tˤuːmuˈːbiːl; attested realisation is /tˤomobil/.

gloss_en: I need a taxi to go
notes: [automotive] MA French loan ṭaksi 'taxi' (harrell1962); pipeline reads the vocalised Arabic word faithfully. baš 'in order to' (harrell1962).

gloss_en: my mom cooks in the kitchen
notes: [daily] MA French/Romance loan kuzina 'kitchen' (harrell1962, heath2020). Pipeline emits a stress+length artifact lkuˈːziːna; attested realisation /kuˈziːna/.

gloss_en: I will go next week
notes: [daily] MA Romance loan simana 'week' (<Sp. semana; harrell1962). Pipeline inserts a spurious glide ssiˈjmaːna; attested realisation /ssiˈmaːna/. ghadi future particle (ennaji2004).

gloss_en: there is no seat in the hall
notes: [daily] MA Romance loan blaṣa 'place/seat' (<Sp./Fr. plaza/place; harrell1962); pipeline reads the vocalised word faithfully (emphatic ṣ). existential negation ma kayn-š (harrell1962).

gloss_en: are you well? how are you today?
notes: [greeting] Moroccan Arabizi: 3=ع. Spells لَباس عْلِيك كِي دايِر الْيُوم (harrell1962 §greetings). Pipeline has no Arabizi path (reads Latin as en-GB loan); IPA hand-derived from the Arabic it spells.

gloss_en: ok, see you tomorrow
notes: [daily] Moroccan Arabizi: 5=خ, gh=غ. Spells واخَّا نْشُوفَك غَدّا (waxxa 'ok', ghedda 'tomorrow'; harrell1962). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic.

gloss_en: I want to know how much this is
notes: [commerce] Moroccan Arabizi: 3=ع, gh→bgh cluster, ch=ʃ. Spells بْغِيت نْعْرَف شّْحال هادا (šḥal 'how much'; harrell1962). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic.
